nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Sustainable development partnerships|Global infrastructure development_qna_000
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What multi-stakeholder initiative is mentioned as being institutionalized through the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)?
nodes.answer: SDG 17 on Partnerships for the Goals is the multi-stakeholder initiative mentioned.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Sustainable development partnerships|Global infrastructure development_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What role does a place-based approach play in sustainability efforts?
nodes.answer: A place-based approach can assist with scaling-up local innovation or scaling-down larger sustainability agendas like the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) to an implementable level.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Sustainable development partnerships|Global infrastructure development_qna_002
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: How can local authorities enhance their efforts in promoting urban sustainability based on the information in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Local authorities can enhance their efforts by collaborating with national, regional, or global networks and initiatives to address environmental vulnerability in urban areas.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Sustainable development partnerships|Global infrastructure development_qna_003
nodes.question: What was the key reason cited by the project coordinator of Euro cities for the success of Sumps in integrating sustainability into mobility plans?
nodes.answer: The project coordinator mentioned that Sumps set an example for smaller cities around those that have implemented the plans, encouraging a top-down approach to sustainable development in Europe.
